files.name: CHANGELOG.md
files.body:
### Features

- **Always search your own Paperless documents:** Nextcloud switches *Search connected services* off on every page that loads, so Paperless results disappeared until you found the switch again. Now each user can select **Always search my Paperless documents** under *Personal settings → Paperless*, and every search of their own includes Paperless from the next page on, without the switch; nobody else’s searches change. Administrators no longer have to choose between sending every term of every user to Paperless and asking everyone to turn the switch on again: they keep *Always include Paperless in global search* for everybody, or turn off the new **Let users include Paperless in all their searches** (on by default, also `occ paperless_unified_search:setup --no-personal-always-search`), which hides the choice and ignores what users chose.
- **French, Spanish and Dutch:** the search, its results, the widget *New in Paperless* on the dashboard, the personal and the administration settings and the warnings of the overview now speak French, Spanish and Dutch to accounts set to these languages, with the words that Nextcloud itself uses there, such as *Rechercher dans les services connectés*, and the listing in the App Store has a summary and a description in each. The texts were drafted with the help of an AI: native speakers are welcome to correct them, and the new page [Translate](https://dennis-otto.github.io/paperless-unified-search/translate.html) shows how, and how to add a language.
- **A warning about a token that may do too much, or too little:** most people paste the API token of their own Paperless account, a superuser, and the test of the connection said that it succeeded; whoever got hold of that token could change and delete every document. Now **Test connection and save**, `occ paperless_unified_search:setup`, `test` and `check` ask Paperless what the account of the token may do, and the settings show a warning below the token, `occ` a line and the administration overview a warning, with what to change, when the account is a superuser or an admin of Paperless or may add, change or delete documents. They also warn when it may not view correspondents or document types, whose names the results then lack. The token is still saved, and the search works as before. Paperless tells this only to an account that may view its UI settings, so give the Paperless account of the search **View** for **Documents**, **Correspondents**, **Document Types** and **UI Settings**, as the documentation now says.
- **The demo shows itself at work:** *Try it in three minutes* in the README and the guide of the demo now show an animation recorded from the real Paperless-ngx and Nextcloud of `bash demo/seed.sh`: jamie searches for *invoice* and opens the home insurance renewal, which only Paperless finds by its text. `bash scripts/screenshots.sh --demo` records it again from a running demo, the same pixels from every fresh demo, and the weekly run of the demo opens a pull request with a new recording when the demo looks different.

### Bug fixes

- **Only the archive shared read-only counts:** a file of the archive account stands for a document only for a user who may only read it. Before, whoever could write into a folder of the archive account, through a share with write permission, could give a file there the marker of any document, such as `Copy [P999].pdf`, and see the title and the excerpt of document 999. If Paperless documents disappear from your search after the update, the archive account shares their folder with you with write permission: ask your administrator to share it read-only. `occ paperless_unified_search:search --explain` and **Try a search** call such a document *writable*.
- **See how the archive is shared:** the settings show below the archive account with how many users, groups and teams it shares its files and how many public links it has, such as *Shared read-only: 1 user, 2 groups.*, and warn about each share that allows changes, with its path and its recipient. `occ paperless_unified_search:check` lists the same, and the overview of the administration settings warns until every share is read-only.

### Performance

- **A lighter home page with an animation you can pause:** the home page of the website loaded the animation of the search as a GIF of almost 400 KB, which looped without end and started on a list of files without a single Paperless result. It now plays a video of about a quarter of that size, which you can pause, in the light or the dark theme of the website. It starts on the Paperless results, in a frame, and shows only that picture when your system asks for less motion; on a phone, the search on a phone takes its place. The screenshots below it no longer move the page as they load, and every PNG is about a quarter smaller, without a changed pixel. The README shows the animation in the dark theme of GitHub too.
